scope: Functional PRACTICAL-GOAL.md kernel/apps; user-requested read-only host ext4 reserve proposal only. No setting change authorized or executed.

mounted_projection.caveat: Projection assumes no concurrent allocation changes. dumpe2fs on-disk Free blocks may lag mounted state; mounted statvfs is the live projection basis. This changes reservation accessibility, not file allocation; it reclaims no allocated bytes.

local_primary_reference.text: Set the number of reserved filesystem blocks.

preconditions: User resolves scope and explicitly authorizes setting change; no automatic execution.
Freshly verify boot, mount device/UUID/major:minor, block size, total/reserved counts, mounted capacity and owner/lease identities.
Independent review of exact operation and rollback, using serialized heavy-operation scope; do not overlap a build/guest.
Preserve 16-GiB host and 12-GiB scratch floors plus packet reserves; included usage stop remains97%.
Preserve all failed/current files, Conda and Tracker; scratch110-GiB backing image and scratch UUID unchanged.
rollback_limits: Restoring original reserved count restores reservation policy, not bytes consumed by intervening writes. If later free space falls below original reservation, ordinary-user availability may become zero; remeasure and review before rollback.
execution: No root command, filesystem mutation, cleanup, archive, Git operation or deletion performed by proposal author.
